checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One ~10s landscape video with music embedded
must.why: 10 s 854x480 mp4 with an audio track (peak -1.5 dB).

must.item: Neon signs, moving train, wet reflections at night
must.why: All three appear in a single street scene: neon signs, a blurred train passing, and wet reflective pavement.
Audio is present, but it cannot be heard. The agent says it is instrumental.

must.item: At least two shot changes on audible beats
must.why: The frames show one continuous camera move through the same scene, with no distinct cuts or separate shots.
No overlay text appears in any frame.

faults.what: There is no montage. It is one slow push-in on a single scene, and the requested cuts between neon signs, train and reflections are absent.
The train is smeared and morphs into a blurry blob by 7 s. Then it disappears by 9.5 s, leaving the bridge empty.
The neon signs warp and change shape over the clip. The left sign becomes a different squiggle, and the key sign shifts.
The agent admitted it never previewed the result.

summary: The output is a 10 s night street with neon, a train and wet reflections, but it is one continuous shot with no beat cuts, and the train smears and vanishes.
